description: Lord armour variants (#1333): tools/generate_lord_armour_variants.py writes one TAOM item per row,
id taom_lord_<source>, the source's Armory look at the lord band of its kingdom line, for the lord
templates of the culture named. A row is allowed only for a piece the curve leaves short of the
lord band for good (worn by a troop, or unworn with no lord-line token); a piece at lord values is
worn as it is. An optional cap {value, reason} holds the primary under the culture's limit where
the lord band would pass it. The key is the template culture (aserai is Harad).
